exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Unrack and lower the bar under control to your lower chest.
Press up and slightly back until your arms are straight over your shoulders.
tips: Keep a slight arch and your glutes on the bench.
Tuck your elbows to about 45–70° from your body.
Use a spotter or safety arms for heavy sets.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.
Lifting the hips off the bench.

ranking.note: Total weight including the bar.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to 30–45° and lie back with the bar over your eyes.
Grip just wider than shoulder width with your shoulder blades pinned back.
Lower the bar to your upper chest just below the collarbones.
Press up until your arms lock out over your shoulders.
tips: A lower incline keeps more of the work on the chest.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.
mistakes: Setting the bench so steep it becomes a shoulder press.
Letting the bar drift toward the face.

ranking.note: Total weight including the bar.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and bring them to chest level.
Start with the dumbbells just outside your chest, palms facing forward.
Press up until your arms are straight, bringing the dumbbells slightly together.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
tips: Dumbbells allow a deeper stretch than a bar.
Kick the dumbbells up from your knees to get into position safely.
mistakes: Dropping the dumbbells down too fast.
Clanging them together at the top.

ranking.note: Weight of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to 30–45° and sit back with the dumbbells at shoulder level.
Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest.
Lower them under control until your elbows are just below the bench line.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades back and down throughout.
Turn your palms slightly in if your shoulders feel pinched.
mistakes: Arching so much that it becomes a flat press.
Cutting the range of motion short.

ranking.note: Weight of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch across your chest.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back up the same arc.
tips: Think of hugging a large tree.
Keep the elbow bend fixed throughout.
mistakes: Turning it into a press by bending the elbows more.
Going too heavy and overstretching the shoulders.

ranking.note: Weight of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and take a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a staggered stance with a slight lean.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Return slowly until your hands are in line with your chest.
tips: Cables keep tension on the chest at the top where dumbbells don't.
Pause and squeeze when the handles meet.
mistakes: Letting the weight yank your arms back.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at the lowest position and grab a handle in each hand.
With arms slightly bent, sweep the handles up and together to upper-chest height.

Keep your chest proud and shoulders down.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press

exercises.name: Push-Up

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
instructions: Set a bar on your upper back.
Step back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to return.
tips: Stepping back is easier on the knees.
Keep your torso upright.

ranking.note: Total weight including the bar.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms in front for balance.
Sit down as low as you comfortably can with your chest up.
Stand back up.
tips: Great warm-up or home workout.
Keep the whole foot planted.

ranking.note: Reps in one set. Weighted sets are converted to bodyweight-equivalent reps.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other straight out in front.
Squat down on the standing leg as low as you can.
Stand back up without touching the free foot down.
tips: Hold a post or sit to a box while learning.
Count reps per leg.

ranking.note: Reps in one set. Weighted sets are converted to bodyweight-equivalent reps.

exercises.name: Band Squat
instructions: Stand on a band and loop it over your shoulders.
Squat down and stand back up against the band.
tips: Hardest at the top where you're strongest.
mistakes: Letting the band pull you forward.

ranking.note: Band tension varies too much to rank fairly.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels and knees just off the bench.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly to straight legs.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad.
Control the way down.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit with the pad behind your lower calves and the thigh pad snug.
Curl your heels down and back under the seat.
Let them rise slowly.
tips: Lean forward slightly for a bigger hamstring stretch.
Pause at full contraction.
mistakes: Loose thigh pad letting you lift up.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored under a pad or by a partner.
Keeping your hips straight, lower your body forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands and pull back up with your hamstrings.
tips: Even slow lowering alone builds strength.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.

ranking.note: Reps in one set. Weighted sets are converted to bodyweight-equivalent reps.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar over your hips.
Plant your feet so your shins are vertical at the top.
Drive your hips up until your body is flat from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly.
tips: Tuck your chin and keep ribs down.
Pause and squeeze at the top.

ranking.note: Total weight including the bar.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly.
tips: Push through your heels.
Do single-leg reps to make it harder.

ranking.note: Reps in one set. Weighted sets are converted to bodyweight-equivalent reps.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley.
Hold the frame and kick your leg straight back.
Squeeze at the top and return slowly.
tips: Keep your torso still.
Small range, full squeeze.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to kick higher.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Sit with the pads against the outside of your knees.
Push your knees out as far as you can.
Return slowly.
tips: Lean forward slightly to bias the upper glutes.
Pause when fully open.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Band Lateral Walk
instructions: Place a loop band around your legs above the knees.
Sit into a quarter squat.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
tips: A great glute warm-up.

ranking.note: Band tension varies too much to rank fairly.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the step with the pads on your shoulders and heels hanging off.
Lower your heels for a deep stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
tips: Pause at the bottom to kill the bounce.
Straight knees work the upper calf.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs and balls of your feet on the step.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Raise them as high as you can.
tips: Bent knees target the deeper soleus.
Slow reps work best.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on a step, holding on for balance.
Lower your heel below the step.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
tips: Hold a dumbbell to add load.
Count reps per leg.

ranking.note: Reps in one set. Weighted sets are converted to bodyweight-equivalent reps.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Raise your legs by curling your pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.
tips: Bent knees make it easier.
Think about curling the hips, not just lifting the legs.
mistakes: Only lifting the legs to hip height.

ranking.note: Reps in one set. Weighted sets are converted to bodyweight-equivalent reps.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley holding a rope beside your head.
Crunch down by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly.
tips: Keep the hips still; only the spine moves.
Exhale hard at the bottom.
mistakes: Sitting back on the heels to pull with the hips.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads on your chest or the handles in hand.
Curl your torso forward and down.
Return slowly.
tips: Lets you add load progressively.
Move through the spine, not the hips.

ranking.note: Machine and cable loads differ between manufacturers, so compare these tiers only on similar equipment.

exercises.name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your temples.
Curl your shoulders off the floor toward your hips.
Lower slowly.
tips: Exhale as you curl up.
Keep your chin off your chest.
mistakes: Yanking the head with the hands.
Sitting all the way up with the hip flexors.

ranking.note: Reps in one set. Weighted sets are converted to bodyweight-equivalent reps.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel holding an ab wheel under your shoulders.
Roll forward slowly, keeping your back from sagging.
Go as far as you can control, then pull back with your abs.
tips: Roll toward a wall to limit range while learning.
Squeeze your glutes.
mistakes: Leading with the hips on the way back.

ranking.note: Reps in one set. Weighted sets are converted to bodyweight-equivalent reps.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Set a pulley high and stand side-on, holding the handle with both hands.
Pull the handle diagonally down across your body, rotating through your torso.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Pivot your back foot.
Keep the arms fairly straight.
mistakes: Twisting the lower back without moving the hips.

ranking.note: Rotation loads aren't comparable enough to rank.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Rotate your torso to touch the floor beside each hip.
Count each side as one rep.
tips: Hold a plate to add load.
Lift your feet to make it harder.

ranking.note: Reps in one set. Weighted sets are converted to bodyweight-equivalent reps.
